about: What search folds, read by tests/test_textfold.py and frontend/src/lib/textFold.test.js so the server index and the browser mirror fold alike.
cases: Vietnamese stacks two marks on one letter
a capital dotted I lowers with a dot, which goes
and the plain spelling meets it
a letter of its own, not a letter with a mark
the stroke is a letter, the acute is a mark
a final sigma reads as a sigma
polytonic Greek loses its breathings and accents
ё meets е, as Russian readers expect
й meets и, an overmatch search accepts
so does the tatweel that stretches a word
the maqaf is punctuation and stays
a Devanagari sign changes the syllable and stays
a dakuten changes the sound and stays
a network keeps its dots and slash
a handle keeps its at sign and underscore
spacing and lines are left alone
